card.name: Last digit of numeric ranges
card.fires_on: A digit, usually the final digit of the upper number in a range such as 15 to 30 or 20 - 30 mm, just before a unit like mg or mm. It also fires on some other digits in measurements.

modes.description: A digit in a size, length or pressure value before cm or mm.
